fullPassage: Hobbies Are Modern Activities Nowadays, everybody has a hobby they like to do in their free time. In the past, though, this probably wasn’t true because most people had to work long hours in agriculture or manufacturing, so free time must have been hard to come by. However, the Industrial Revolution and the labor movement that followed it led to a gradual decrease in working hours to eight-hour work days and five-day work weeks. For the first time in history, a majority of people had free time to enjoy activities that they found meaningful outside of work: hobbies. Hobbies Are Serious For many people, hobbies are serious. Serious leisure may sound like a contradiction, but that’s what it takes for an activity to qualify as a hobby. To take a hobby seriously, you have to make a meaningful effort to improve your skills, take risks, overcome hardships, or become a better version of yourself. If you meet someone who has woken up at the crack of dawn to take a picture at the “magic hour,” you can assume that they think of themselves as a “photographer.” A runner, a gamer, or a photographer are titles that people are proud to call themselves. On the other hand, you wouldn’t call yourself a “TV watcher” or “online surfer.” Watching TV and surfing online aren’t considered serious hobbies because there’s no challenge or way to improve yourself. Hobbies Create Community J. R. R. Tolkien, the author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, was passionate about language. He invented languages with grammar rules and histories: Sindarin and Quenya, the former inspired by Welsh, and the latter inspired by Finnish and Latin. But inventing languages was a frustrating hobby because he had to isolate himself while creating them. He wrote of the isolation that he and other people who loved languages experienced: “But they become shy, ashamed of spending the valuable commodity of time for their private pleasure, and higher developments are locked in secret places.” Things are very different now. The Internet allows people to learn about languages and meet other language enthusiasts from all over the world. Instead of working on their projects in private, they can easily find other like-minded people to share their passion, celebrate their achievements, and encourage each other along the way. They could even work together on language projects that Tolkien may have never been able to imagine. Hobbies Are Gratifying While some people pursue a hobby to improve their skills, some do for the sheer pleasure of doing it. Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old, venturing out on the lakes in Switzerland and simply enjoying the time on his boat. He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor. Although he is considered a genius in physics, he wasn’t a good sailor, nor did he care about his sailing technique. His technique remained at a basic level, which was simply to “Set sail, make it fast, no thoughts of energy or speed, lean back, let the boat drift.” On a boat, he forgot everything else in the world, which may explain why he enjoyed sailing so much. For him, it was being out on the water that mattered the most. Einstein used the hobby of sailing to go to a place where he could be completely relaxed. Maybe that’s why he named his boat Tinef, meaning “worthless” in Yiddish, after the apparent meaninglessness of his sailing adventures. Watching the waves while on his boat, Einstein forgot all his worries. Like Einstein, for many people, hobbies just provide the conditions for a sense of pure satisfaction. Hobbies Can Contribute You may be surprised to find that pursuing a hobby can accomplish more than self-satisfaction. That is, it sometimes leads to an unexpected contribution to society. For example, Thomas Bopp, a manager at a construction materials factory and an amateur astronomer, discovered the comet Hale-Bopp while observing the sky with his friends in the Arizona desert. To make the story even more shocking, he was using a borrowed telescope that his friend had assembled himself. And Bopp is not alone. Numerous amateur astronomers have discovered comets, stars, and supernovas, which helps us to better understand the solar system and the universe. Amateurs in many other fields have made important contributions through their hobbies, such as amateur programmers developing new technologies, amateur writers publishing their work in local magazines, amateur history researchers preserving historical sites ... The list goes on and on! There are many reasons why people pursue hobbies. For many people, the challenge of learning a new skill or achieving a difficult goal is their primary motivation. Other people enjoy hobbies for the communities they can become a part of or the friendships they can make there. Still others enjoy hobbies because they can lose track of time and be in the moment, similar to being in a meditative state. Some people even end up making contributions to society through their hobbies, oftentimes unexpectedly. It is the physical, mental, or emotional experience, or even a combination of them, that makes a hobby rewarding and fun. Perhaps it should be called “pleisure.” Read More The PCT: A Life-Changing Experience Long-distance hiking trails are becoming popular with more and more people. Let’s explore the appeal of long-distance hiking through a famous trail, the PCT. What Is the PCT? The PCT, or Pacific Crest Trail, is a 4,265-kilometer long hiking trail that stretches vertically across the U.S. Being so long, it crosses three states and seven national parks. Hikers can experience a varied range of landscapes, from hot desert regions to great mountain ranges. It takes about five months for the average person to walk through the trail, which is known as thru-hiking. “Thru-hikers” usually start in early spring and head north, arriving at their destination in early winter. It’s a hard journey with a low completion rate; just 14% of all hikers attempting a thru-hiking succeed in finishing the PCT. What Challenges Are There? In addition to the physical difficulties and mental isolation, surviving in nature for months itself can be a tremendous challenge. Hikers cook their own meals, and sometimes they have to endure days without eating. Securing water is another crucial requirement because not all the water sources are safe to drink. Hikers are advised to carry the latest PCT Water Report, a list of all water sources. When it comes to sleeping, most hikers sleep in tents, and in some areas, they can use shelters to stay safe from the harsh weather. If you are lucky, you may find “trail angels,” who provide transportation to close towns, meals, or other forms of assistance. Why Do They Bother? Hear from Finishers. • While the PCT was demanding, it was also a gift. It allowed me to see what I am truly capable of. • Traveling the PCT can be about the people you meet along the way. The trail has led to lasting friendships. • The PCT is a journey of a lifetime. It is a chance to see the magnificent landscapes of the American West.

✅ ① 본문 'Tolkien, the author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings'로 두 작품의 작가라 했으므로 일치
✅ ② 본문 'He invented languages with grammar rules and histories'로 문법 규칙과 역사를 갖춘 언어를 만들었다 했으므로 일치
✅ ③ 본문 'The Internet allows people to learn about languages and meet other language enthusiasts from all over the world'로 전 세계 언어 애호가를 만날 수 있다 했으므로 일치
❌ ④ 본문은 언어를 만드는 일이 스스로를 고립시켜야 하는 frustrating한 취미였다고 했으므로, '여럿이 함께 작업하며 매우 즐거워했다'는 사실과 달라 불일치 ←정답
det.tip: isolate himself(고립되어야 했다), frustrating(좌절스러운)이 ④를 걸러 내는 단서입니다.

ch: 톨킨은 The Hobbit과 The Lord of the Rings의 작가이다.
톨킨은 문법 규칙과 역사를 갖춘 언어들을 만들어 냈다.
인터넷 덕분에 사람들은 전 세계의 다른 언어 애호가들을 만날 수 있다.
톨킨은 여러 사람과 함께 작업하며 언어를 만들어 매우 즐거워했다.

questions.passage: Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old, venturing out on the lakes in Switzerland and simply enjoying the time on his boat.  He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor.  Although he is considered a genius in physics, he wasn’t a good sailor, nor did he care about his sailing technique.  His technique remained at a basic level, which was simply to “Set sail, make it fast, no thoughts of energy or speed, lean back, let the boat drift. ” On a boat, he forgot everything else in the world, which may explain why he enjoyed sailing so much.  For him, it was being out on the water that mattered the most.  Einstein used the hobby of sailing to go to a place where he could be completely relaxed.
questions.stem: 위 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문 'Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old'로 18세에 시작했으므로 '40세'는 불일치
❌ ② 본문 'he wasn't a good sailor'로 좋은 항해사가 아니었다 했으므로 '뛰어난 실력으로 유명한 항해사'는 불일치
✅ ③ 본문 'he named his boat Tinef, meaning "worthless" in Yiddish'로 배에 '쓸모없는'이라는 뜻의 이름을 붙였다 했으므로 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ 본문 'no thoughts of energy or speed'로 에너지나 속도는 생각하지 않았다 했으므로 '계산하며 집중했다'는 불일치
det.tip: 18 years old, wasn't a good sailor, no thoughts of energy or speed 같은 표현으로 오답을 걸러내세요.

ch: 아인슈타인은 뛰어난 항해 실력으로 유명한 항해사였다.
아인슈타인은 자신의 배에 '쓸모없는'이라는 뜻의 이름을 붙였다.
아인슈타인은 항해할 때 에너지와 속도를 계산하며 집중했다.

questions.passage: The PCT, or Pacific Crest Trail, is a 4,265-kilometer long hiking trail ①<u>that stretches</u> vertically across the U. S.  ②<u>Been so long</u>, it crosses three states and seven national parks.  Hikers can experience a varied range of landscapes, from hot desert regions to great mountain ranges.  It takes about five months for the average person ③<u>to walk</u> through the trail, which is known as thru-hiking.  “Thru-hikers” usually start in early spring and head north, arriving at their destination in early winter.  It’s a hard journey with a low completion rate; just 14% of all hikers attempting a thru-hiking ④<u>succeed in finishing</u> the PCT.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: Been so long → Being so long (분사구문)
det.analysis:
✅ ① that stretches: 선행사 a hiking trail(단수)을 받는 주격 관계대명사 that의 동사로 수 일치가 맞아 적절
❌ ② Been so long → Being so long: 주절의 주어 it과 능동 관계인 분사구문이므로 현재분사 Being이 옳다. 과거분사 Been은 분사구문 주어로 쓸 수 없어 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ to walk: It takes about five months ... to walk — 가주어 It에 대한 진주어 to부정사로 적절
✅ ④ succeed in finishing: 전치사 in 뒤에 오는 동명사 finishing으로 '완주하는 데 성공하다'는 구조로 적절
det.tip: 분사구문의 주어가 능동으로 행위를 하면 Being(현재분사)을 씁니다. Been은 분사구문을 이끌 수 없습니다.

Maybe that’s why he named his boat Tinef, meaning “worthless” in Yiddish, after the apparent meaninglessness of his sailing adventures.  Watching the waves while on his boat, Einstein forgot all his worries.

det.analysis: 본문 'Watching the waves while on his boat, Einstein forgot all his worries.'에서 아인슈타인은 배 위에서 파도를 보며 '모든 걱정(all his worries)'을 잊었다고 했다.
det.tip: forgot all his worries(모든 걱정을 잊었다)에서 forgot의 목적어를 찾습니다.

Amateurs in many other fields have made important contributions through their hobbies, such as amateur programmers developing new technologies, amateur writers publishing their work in local magazines, amateur history researchers preserving historical sites ...
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 아마추어 천문학자들의 발견이 우리가 무엇을 더 잘 이해하도록 돕는지 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (6단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 본문 'Numerous amateur astronomers have discovered comets, stars, and supernovas, which helps us to better understand the solar system and the universe.'에서 그들의 발견이 우리가 '태양계와 우주(the solar system and the universe)'를 더 잘 이해하도록 돕는다고 했다.
det.tip: better understand의 목적어 부분을 그대로 찾습니다.

questions.wa: the solar system and the universe
accept: the solar system and the universe

questions.passage: For him, it was being out on the water that mattered the most. Einstein used the hobby of sailing to go to a place where he could be __________ (complete) relaxed.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.analysis: 구문 분석: could be 뒤 형용사 relaxed를 수식하는 자리이므로, 형용사 complete를 부사 completely로 바꿔야 한다. '완전히 편안해질 수 있는 곳'이라는 의미로 부사가 형용사를 꾸민다.
det.tip: 형용사(relaxed) 앞에서 정도를 나타내며 꾸미는 자리에는 부사(completely)를 씁니다.

questions.passage: Hobbies Are Modern Activities Nowadays, everybody has a hobby they like to do in their free time.  In the past, though, this probably wasn’t true because most people had to work long hours in agriculture or manufacturing, so free time must have been hard to come by.  However, the Industrial Revolution and the labor movement that followed it led to a gradual decrease in working hours to eight-hour work days and five-day work weeks.  For the first time in history, a majority of people had free time to enjoy activities that they found meaningful outside of work: hobbies.  Hobbies Are Serious For many people, hobbies are serious.  Serious leisure may sound like a contradiction, but that’s what it takes for an activity to qualify as a hobby.  To take a hobby seriously, you have to make a meaningful effort to improve your skills, take risks, overcome hardships, or become a better version of yourself.  If you meet someone who has woken up at the crack of dawn to take a picture at the “magic hour,” you can assume that they think of themselves as a “photographer. ” A runner, a gamer, or a photographer are titles that people are proud to call themselves.  On the other hand, you wouldn’t call yourself a “TV watcher” or “online surfer. ” Watching TV and surfing online aren’t considered serious hobbies because there’s no challenge or way to improve yourself.  Hobbies Create Community J.  R.  R.  Tolkien, the author of The Hobbit and The Lord of the Rings, was passionate about language.  He invented languages with grammar rules and histories: Sindarin and Quenya, the former inspired by Welsh, and the latter inspired by Finnish and Latin.  But inventing languages was a frustrating hobby because he had to isolate himself while creating them.  He wrote of the isolation that he and other people who loved languages experienced: “But they become shy, ashamed of spending the valuable commodity of time for their private pleasure, and higher developments are locked in secret places. ” Things are very different now.  The Internet allows people to learn about languages and meet other language enthusiasts from all over the world.  Instead of working on their projects in private, they can easily find other like-minded people to share their passion, celebrate their achievements, and encourage each other along the way.  They could even work together on language projects that Tolkien may have never been able to imagine.  Hobbies Are Gratifying While some people pursue a hobby to improve their skills, some do for the sheer pleasure of doing it.  Albert Einstein started learning to sail when he was 18 years old, venturing out on the lakes in Switzerland and simply enjoying the time on his boat.  He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor.  Although he is considered a genius in physics, he wasn’t a good sailor, nor did he care about his sailing technique.  His technique remained at a basic level, which was simply to “Set sail, make it fast, no thoughts of energy or speed, lean back, let the boat drift. ” On a boat, he forgot everything else in the world, which may explain why he enjoyed sailing so much.  For him, it was being out on the water that mattered the most.  Einstein used the hobby of sailing to go to a place where he could be completely relaxed.  Maybe that’s why he named his boat Tinef, meaning “worthless” in Yiddish, after the apparent meaninglessness of his sailing adventures.  Watching the waves while on his boat, Einstein forgot all his worries.  Like Einstein, for many people, hobbies just provide the conditions for a sense of pure satisfaction.  Hobbies Can Contribute You may be surprised to find that pursuing a hobby can accomplish more than self-satisfaction.  That is, it sometimes leads to an unexpected contribution to society.  For example, Thomas Bopp, a manager at a construction materials factory and an amateur astronomer, discovered the comet Hale-Bopp while observing the sky with his friends in the Arizona desert.  To make the story even more shocking, he was using a borrowed telescope that his friend had assembled himself.  And Bopp is not alone.  Numerous amateur astronomers have discovered comets, stars, and supernovas, which helps us to better understand the solar system and the universe.  Amateurs in many other fields have made important contributions through their hobbies, such as amateur programmers developing new technologies, amateur writers publishing their work in local magazines, amateur history researchers preserving historical sites ...  The list goes on and on!  There are many reasons why people pursue hobbies.  For many people, the challenge of learning a new skill or achieving a difficult goal is their primary motivation.  Other people enjoy hobbies for the communities they can become a part of or the friendships they can make there.  Still others enjoy hobbies because they can lose track of time and be in the moment, similar to being in a meditative state.  Some people even end up making contributions to society through their hobbies, oftentimes unexpectedly.  It is the physical, mental, or emotional experience, or even a combination of them, that makes a hobby rewarding and fun.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① 취미의 현대적 기원, 진지함, 공동체, 만족감, 사회 기여까지 — 취미가 현대인에게 갖는 여러 의미와 가치를 두루 다루는 글 전체의 중심 소재 ←정답
❌ ② 산업혁명은 취미 등장의 배경으로 잠깐 언급될 뿐, 부정적 영향이 주제는 아님
❌ ③ 톨킨·아인슈타인·톰 보프는 취미를 설명하는 예시일 뿐, 과학적 업적 자체가 주제는 아님
❌ ④ 장거리 하이킹은 Read More의 부수적 내용이라 글 전체 주제가 아님
det.tip: 주제는 세부 예시가 아니라 글 전체를 관통하는 중심 소재를 골라야 합니다.

questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문은 순수한 즐거움만으로 취미를 하는 사람도 있다고 했으므로 '실력 향상 목표일 때만 가치 있다'는 지나친 단정
❌ ② 공동체는 취미의 한 측면일 뿐, 반드시 함께해야 한다는 주장은 아님
❌ ③ 여가 시간 부족은 과거의 상황으로 언급될 뿐 글의 요지가 아님
✅ ④ 취미가 즐거움과 자기 발전을 넘어 공동체와 사회 기여로까지 이어지는 의미 있는 활동이라는 것이 글 전체를 관통하는 핵심 메시지 ←정답
det.tip: 요지는 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 주장으로, 여러 문단의 내용을 아우르는 진술을 고릅니다.

ch: 취미는 반드시 실력 향상을 목표로 할 때에만 가치가 있다.
진정한 취미가 되려면 반드시 다른 사람과 함께해야 한다.
대부분의 사람은 여가 시간이 부족해 취미를 갖기 어렵다.
취미는 즐거움을 넘어 자기 발전과 공동체, 사회 기여로 이어지는 의미 있는 활동이다.

questions.stem:
위 글의 내용을 바탕으로, 다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 영작하시오. (영어로)

'그는 평생 항해자로서 항해를 계속 즐겼다.'

[조건]
(1) a, as, continued, enjoy, He, life-long, sailing, sailor, to를 모두 사용할 것
(2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것

det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- He(주어) + continued(동사) + to enjoy sailing(목적어, to부정사): 그는 항해를 즐기는 것을 계속했다
- as a life-long sailor(전치사구): 평생 항해자로서
- continue to V (계속 ~하다)와 as(~로서)를 활용한 구조
det.tip: continue to enjoy(계속 즐기다)에 as a life-long sailor(평생 항해자로서)를 붙여 완성합니다.

questions.wa: He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor
accept: He continued to enjoy sailing as a life-long sailor
